shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling, needs, work and storage come free from vanilla. Full cross-level combat, senses, NPC travel, and a Combat Extended bridge. LIVE IN OPEN BETA as Workshop item 3776015553 (window-3 build); window-4 prep now STALE AGAIN - two post-prep fixes landed (save/load transit death, start-spot edge ladder), both built and unverified.

**What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities: visual clarity from above, performance, vanilla parity.

**⚠⚠ THE FOUR RULES THIS PROJECT PAID THE MOST FOR:**
1. **NOTHING COSMETIC ON DECIDING PATHS** (§33c); **CLAMP AT SELECTION** (§35).
2. **NEVER PATCH `TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms`** - use `RegionsRoomsChanged` (§34e) - **AND REPLAY THE ACCIDENTAL WORK WHEN YOU DO (§29c)**.
3. **REGION CONNECTIVITY IS MORE OPTIMISTIC THAN THE PATHFINDER** (§34b): flood CELLS.
4. **COUNT THE EMITTERS AND THE POPULATIONS** (§39/§41/§42/§43) - and **THE ENGINE STACKS** (§44).

**⚠ NEXT-SESSION QUEUE, in order:** (1) **verify §29c in-game** (save → reload → cross-level job WITHOUT building anything first) - it is the open-beta-critical fix; (2) §43 + §44 CE verification launches; (3) commit the fixes, redo the mechanical prep, answer §31b, upload; (4) §13 list.

# 1. ARCHITECTURE
One `Map`, `(w, 1, bandCount*Slot)`; `Slot = ceil((bandHeight+2)/64)*64`; 64-alignment load-bearing.
**The one insight:** `Region.Neighbors` is topological; Portal wormholes conduct connectivity without merging rooms/temp/vacuum; the jobified pathfinder cannot cross a synthetic link → segmented movement.
**⚠⚠ `CanReach` = "with stairs"; pathfinder = "walking now"** (§34, §40).
**⚠⚠ SYNTHETIC LINKS ARE WIPED BY EVERY REGION REBUILD AND ARMED ONLY BY OUR HOOK (§29c): any path where a rebuild happens without the hook firing afterwards = the whole mod silently off.** Known instance: load (fixed by the initial arm). Audit candidates: pocket maps? map generation of a SECOND colony map while the first lives? Keep the question alive.
**⚠ THE TOPOLOGICAL TRICK GENERALISES TO NEITHER UTILITIES NOR COMBAT (§41i); it is why exits leaked before §43.**
**⚠ THE GUTTER:** shells scatter into it (§41f), radial searches reach it (§41i), skyfaller offsets cross it (§41b), spanning shoot lines walk through it (§41k), **CE rounds would COLLIDE through it (§44)**, **and the start-spot's scatter can cross it (§29d)**.
**⚠ THE VIEW IS DOWNWARD-ONLY; physics, combat rendering, sound and traffic are symmetric.**
**⚠⚠ ANISOTROPY BREAKS EVERY RAW DISTANCE TEST.** `BandOf` CLAMPS.

### ⚠ THE SLICING RULE, ten shapes — anchor/field/noise/extent/aspect/scalar/foreign-writes/radius-vs-gutter/list-sweep/raw-participant-maths. `ABBandLocal.cs` is the canonical FIELD rewrite. Unaudited: Basin, Cavern, Chasm, Cliffs, Hollow, Valley.

# 2. LEVEL PLAN — 126/128 (7 cap) · **190/192 (4)** · 254/256 (2); one efficient height per 64-step; 200 is the number to avoid; plan persists between colonies.

# 3-8a. MOVEMENT, MASS, CAMERA — segmented at `StartPath`; hops strictly decrease; multi-hop ✅. TWO CARRY TRIGGERS, must agree on the ending (§33c/h). **ONE DESCENT RULE + ONE SANCTIONED SIBLING (`ABShaft.ColumnOpen`).** 4d closed the last single-band corner.

# 8b. DEPTH SHRINK — loose contents only; terrain never; no shrink for flecks/relayed things.

# 9. GENERATION COST — FillRock tracks HILLINESS; RAINFALL dominates Plants. **⚠⚠ HILLINESS DECIDES TEST VALIDITY (test combat OUTDOORS).** *(Run 407/409 reference: Tundra/Flat/swamp 0.28, 5 bands of 126, ~1151 ms gensteps + ~906 ms carve.)* **⚠ SWAMPY FLAT TILES ARE THE START-SPOT STRESS CASE (§29d): "flat" does not mean "standable".**

# 10-12. PERF AND DIAGNOSTICS
**⚠ BISECT TOGGLES PERSIST. ⚠ Palette strips its LAST entry (pad it). ⚠ OUR REPORTS = warning rows; `monitor_get_error` bodies; `monitor_poll` counts.**
**⚠⚠ A CLEAN LOG IS NOT A WORKING FEATURE; NEITHER IS A ONE-POPULATION PASS; NEITHER IS A LAUNCH THE HUMAN DID NOT REPORT BACK ON.**
**⚠⚠ BUILD THE DETECTOR WHEN READING WON'T YIELD. ⚠⚠ A DIAGNOSTIC THAT CAN SILENCE ITSELF IS A TRAP. ⚠⚠ AN INSTRUMENT CAN BE FOOLED BY THE TERM IT HUNTS. ⚠⚠ SILENT FALLBACK BRANCHES MUST LOG THEIR CENSUS (§29d: the wide branch decided silently; the bug was diagnosed backwards from a rescue message).**
**⚠ CIRCINUS: python, not jq.**

# 14. LESSONS
**Method.** Prove innocence by finding a state where the suspect CANNOT EXIST. One change per experiment. Diagnostic before theory; after five failed theories, SHIP THE INSTRUMENT.
**⚠⚠ COUNT EMITTERS/HOMES/POPULATIONS/DERIVATIONS/SENSES/DIRECTIONS/ENGINE STACKS - AND GAME LIFECYCLES (§29c: new-game vs load are two lifecycles; a hook tested only on one is half-tested).**
**⚠⚠ AN EVENT SUBSCRIPTION ONLY SEES CHANGES AFTER IT EXISTS (§29c).** Replacing an always-running patch with an event MUST replay the work the polling did by accident - the initial arm after load. `Map.FinalizeInit` rebuilds regions BEFORE components' `FinalizeInit`; anything armed from `RegionsRoomsChanged` is dead on load until the first genuine region change. Fix shape: shared handler body + `LongEventHandler.ExecuteWhenFinished` initial call (FinalizeInit is on the worker thread).
**⚠⚠ SUPPRESSING A DRAW IS SAFE; SUPPRESSING A BAKE IS NOT (§29b). ⚠⚠ A SKIPPED `Regenerate` IS STILL MARKED CLEAN (§29b). ⚠⚠ A MUTABLE GLOBAL IN A SKIP CONDITION IS A PROMISE TO DIRTY ON EVERY TRANSITION (§29b). ⚠⚠ MECHANICAL PREP IS NOT PROGRESS WHEN THE BLOCKER IS EDITORIAL (window 4, twice). ⚠⚠ A REMAP CAN NEUTRALIZE YOUR OWN DOWNSTREAM HOOK (§44).**
**⚠⚠ FALLBACKS THAT DECIDE SILENTLY GET DIAGNOSED BACKWARDS (§29d):** the wide start-spot branch chose an edge cell with no log; the only trace was the rescue warning two gensteps later. Every fallback DECISION logs its census now; a preference ladder (24→12→6→0) beats a preference cliff (24→0).
**⚠⚠ SURFACE-ONLY-BY-ACCIDENT IS NOT A RULE (§43). ⚠⚠ SECOND ENTRY POINTS, NOT FACTION CHECKS (§41i). ⚠⚠ HELPERS REIMPLEMENTING RANGE/BEARING/ANCHOR MATHS ARE INVISIBLE TO VERB PATCHES (n=8). ⚠⚠ "DECLINE TO HELP" IS NOT "DENY" (§41c). ⚠⚠ MOVEMENT SYMPTOMS CAN BE RANGE CHECKS. ⚠⚠ THE MISS PATHS ARE A SECOND FEATURE. ⚠⚠ ONE-PAWN-TYPE REPORTS AREN'T TYPE-SPECIFIC. ⚠⚠ DERIVED ANSWERS CAN'T BEAT SOURCES. ⚠⚠ BLIND INSTRUMENTS. ⚠⚠ TELEPORT EXITS RE-DISPATCH. ⚠⚠ thingIDNumber STATICS. ⚠⚠ ONE GESTURE, THREE PATHS. ⚠⚠ REVERT-FIRST. ⚠⚠ CHECK WHETHER IT'S ALREADY BUILT (§29d: the margin fix "to apply" already existed; the work was finding why it missed).**
**⚠ THE USER'S EYE BEATS THE AGENT'S ARITHMETIC (§41l) - A PLAYER'S CODE REVIEW BEATS BOTH (§29b) - AND A PLAYER'S SAVE FILE BEATS ALL THREE (§29c: the dev loop never reloads a settled colony; players do it daily).** **⚠ VERIFY "FALSE POSITIVES" AGAINST THE SOURCE, DON'T ASSUME THEM. ⚠ INVESTIGATE COUNT DISCREPANCIES BEFORE RECORDING THEM. ⚠ FALSE COMMENTS OUTLIVE THEIR TRUTH WINDOW (ABSkySync called RoofSync "unused" after adopting it as its own kill switch - a cleanup pass trusting that comment would have deleted a live guard; the V1-scan's only real finding). ⚠ FLAVOR NEVER BREAKS AN INCIDENT. ⚠ PARTICIPATION BY ALLOWLIST. ⚠ A SHADOW CAN BE DRAWN WHERE NOBODY LOOKS. ⚠ HONESTY RULES CAN BE REPLACED BY MORE HONEST RULES. ⚠ EXACT-MATCH KEYS ON SCATTERED VALUES MISS ON EVERY MISS. ⚠ FOUR CASES, ONE DEFECT. ⚠ IMPOSSIBLE FEATURES MAY BE FREE. ⚠ GUARDS ARE PER-CONSUMER. ⚠ COUNT CONSUMERS. ⚠ A ROUNDING-ERROR OPTIMISATION IS NOT WORTH A CORRECTNESS HAZARD. ⚠ FUNNEL BRANCHES LIE UNEQUALLY. ⚠ COPY GOES STALE; NEVER UPDATE AHEAD OF VERIFICATION - NOR AHEAD OF THE SHIPPED BUILD (§31c). ⚠ RECORD FALSE POSITIVES. ⚠ DOCUMENTED ROUNDING ERRORS CAN BEAT FRAGILE FIXES.** *(One-liner archive unchanged.)*
**Patching.** Wrap DATA; patch PRODUCERS; INNER METHODS over wrappers; no foreign types in patch signatures (§44); prefix releases in FINALIZERS; `[ThreadStatic]` latches; RE-ENTER WITH CORRECTED INPUTS; REIMPLEMENT WHEN GUARDS SIT AHEAD; POSTFIX-CORRECT COSMETICS; BOX/SETVALUE/UNBOX structs; REBUILD IMMUTABLE-ANCHOR STRUCTS; gate LIFETIME or OBSERVER; SUPPRESS AT `Visible`, NEVER AT `Regenerate` (§29b); **EVENT SUBSCRIPTIONS NEED AN INITIAL REPLAY (§29c)**.
**Engine facts.** *(archive unchanged.)* **NEW: `Map.FinalizeInit` order is RebuildAllRegionsAndRooms → ... → MapComponents' FinalizeInit LAST (load AND new game); `TryFindStartCell`-style radial searches return the cell NEAREST THE SEED, so a fallback over a wider rect gravitates to the failed rect's border.**

## 29c. SAVE/LOAD KILLED ALL CROSS-LEVEL FUNCTION (user-reported, FIXED, BUILT UNVERIFIED)
**Symptom:** after save + reload, cross-level bills, hauling, construction - everything - silently stops. No error, no guard trip.
**Root cause:** `ABWormholeRearmHook.Register` (the perf rework that replaced the 4,500-calls/frame postfix with a `RegionsRoomsChanged` subscription) only SUBSCRIBES. On load, `Map.FinalizeInit` runs `RebuildAllRegionsAndRooms` BEFORE MapComponents' `FinalizeInit` - so the load's one rebuild predates the subscription, zero synthetic links exist, and no event is due until the first genuine region change of the session. New games never showed it because generation keeps dirtying regions after registration. The old wasteful postfix had been healing this hole every frame BY ACCIDENT; the rework removed the waste and the accidental initial arm together.
**Fix:** handler body extracted to a shared `Rearm(Map)`; subscription calls it; PLUS an initial `LongEventHandler.ExecuteWhenFinished(Rearm)` at registration (main-thread deferral because FinalizeInit runs on the LongEvent worker thread). Idempotent - on new games it is one redundant arm.
**Verify by:** quicktest → stairs → confirm a cross-level order works → save → load the save → confirm the same order works WITHOUT building anything first.

## 29d. START SPOT AT THE BAND EDGE (run #409 near-miss, FIXED, BUILT UNVERIFIED)
Run #409 (Tundra, Flat, swamp 0.28): the 24-cell-margin safe strip had no standable dry cell, and the old fallback chain jumped straight from margin-24 to margin-0 - where `TryFindStartCell`'s seed-radial pass returned the nearest qualifying cell, z=251, THREE cells from the band's top edge. Spawn scatter crossed the gutter; two colonists were saved only by `RescueStrandedColonists`. **The margin fix "to apply" already existed** - the work was discovering why it missed. **Fix:** `TryFindSteppedMarginCell` ladder (24 → 12 → 6 → 0) replacing the cliff, plus a Dev log with the failed rung's census on every step-down (the old wide branch decided silently). The rescue stays - it is the backstop, not the policy.
